title: CVForge cover letter
description: One application's cover letter. The sender - your name, tagline, contacts, address and signature - is NOT here: it is read from data/cv-<lang>.yaml and data/private.yaml, so the letterhead can never disagree with the CV.

lang.description: Language of this letter. Picks the data/cv-<lang>.yaml the sender identity is read from, and the label set used for the subject, salutation and closing.

slug.description: Must match the directory name under applications/. Keeps a copied letter.yaml from silently building under the wrong name.

date.description: The date the letter is sent, as a quoted "YYYY-MM-DD". Omit or null for the build date, which is what you want right up until you build a letter you already sent.

recipient.description: The address field. Company postal addresses are public imprint data and are tracked; anything about a person beyond the name in the salutation belongs in the gitignored dossier.yaml.

department.description: Optional line under the company, e.g. 'Personalabteilung' or a team name.

person.description: Named recipient, e.g. 'Frau Anna Beispiel'. Printed in the address field. Does NOT compose the salutation - German forms of address need a gender the data does not carry, so set `salutation` explicitly when you want a named one.

salutation.description: The full salutation line including its comma, e.g. 'Sehr geehrte Frau Beispiel,'. Omit for the generic form for this language.

postal_code.description: Quoted - a German postcode like "01067" loses its leading zero as a number.

country.description: Printed only when set. Leave it out for a domestic recipient.

title.description: The role as the posting words it. Composes the subject line.

reference.description: Kennziffer / requisition id. Rendered in the info block beside the address field and appended to the subject. A posting that carries one usually expects to see it back.

source.description: Where you found it, as a full phrase in this letter's language, e.g. 'Ihre Anzeige auf StepStone vom 04.09.2026'. Rendered in the info block.

url.description: The posting URL. Recorded, never rendered - a printed letter cannot be clicked. The archived copy belongs in the gitignored posting/ directory.

subject.description: Overrides the composed subject line entirely. Composed form is '<prefix> <job.title>' plus the reference when there is one.

sender_contacts.description: Which contacts appear in the letterhead, by their id in data/cv-<lang>.yaml. Omit for all of them. The letterhead has to fit above the address field, so a long contact row is the first thing to trim here.

body.description: The paragraphs, in order. Use folded (>) scalars.

closing.description: Overrides the closing formula, e.g. 'Mit freundlichen Gruessen'. Omit for this language's default.

enclosures.description: The 'Anlagen:' line under the signature. Omit for none.

slug.description: Lowercase kebab-case. Date-prefixing (2026-09-acme-…) sorts the applications directory chronologically.
